summary: 10.0.41.02 Universal Zero-FOUC Refresh Architecture: pre-paint route, branding, clock, badges, footer, and workspace-tab hydration
highlights: 1. Universal Zero-Flash Routing: Synchronous pre-paint route resolution in <head> guarantees that refreshing on any screen (Purchase, Bank, Sales, Quotations, Items, etc.) renders the target view from frame 0 with zero dashboard flash.

2. Immediate Clock & Footer Hydration: Live clock starts in <head> before fonts or any script loads. Footer populates from localStorage on parse, never showing hardcoded placeholder dates or company names.
3. Badge Zero-State Desktop Parity: All 4 header action badges (Reminders, Notifications, Email, WhatsApp) start completely hidden (display:none) matching Desktop applyBadge(count > 0) contract.
4. Dynamic Company Branding: Header brand-title hydrates from localStorage[dse_branding] synchronously before Frame 0 paint - zero JASVI INDUSTRIES flash on any refresh.
5. Workspace Tabs & Page Title Pre-Hydration: Active module title, breadcrumb, and tab bar rendered before JS execution.
6. DOMContentLoaded Boot Acceleration: App.init() migrated from window.load to DOMContentLoaded for 50-100ms faster initialization.
